description: Cover Art Archive images for a release or release-group MBID: front/back flags, image types, full-resolution URLs, and 250/500/1200px thumbnail URLs. limit defaults to 25 and clamps above 100; offset defaults to 0. Pages retain archive order, totalCount counts all images, and hasArt describes the full archive even on an empty page. Follow the notice for the next offset. No art is a successful empty result; an unknown MBID fails with entity_not_found after a bounded MusicBrainz check. A release-group resolves to a representative release's art. URLs are linked, never rehosted; image copyright stays with rights holders.

entity_type.description: Whether the MBID is a release (default) or a release-group.

limit.description: Maximum images returned (default 25; values above 100 clamp to 100 with a notice).

mbid.description: Release or release-group MBID (hyphenated hexadecimal UUID; surrounding whitespace and uppercase accepted).

offset.description: Zero-based image offset in archive order (default 0).

name: musicbrainz_get_cover_art

cap.description: Applied image limit when more remain.

entityType.description: Whether the MBID was treated as a release or release-group.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_mbid`: The MBID is malformed or the all-zeros sentinel (rejected before fetch), or an upstream rejects it with HTTP 400. `entity_not_found`: The MBID is well-formed but no entity of the given entity_type exists with it (the archive returns 404 and the MusicBrainz check of the MBID returns 404). Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

hasArt.description: Whether any cover art exists for this entity.

images.description: Selected cover-art images in archive order (empty for no art or an exhausted page).

items.description: One cover-art image with its full URL and thumbnails.

approved.description: Whether the image is community-approved. Omitted when unknown.

back.description: Whether this is a designated back image.

comment.description: Editor comment on the image. Omitted when absent.

front.description: Whether this is a designated front image.

imageUrl.description: Full-resolution image URL (linked, not rehosted — copyright stays with the rights holder).

types.description: Image types (Front, Back, Booklet, Medium, …; may be empty).

notice.description: Combined limit clamp, continuation, exhausted page, or no-art/existence-unconfirmed guidance.

offset.description: Effective zero-based image offset in archive order.

representativeRelease.description: For a release-group query, the release MBID whose art was returned. Omitted for direct release queries.

totalCount.description: Exact image total before the limit and offset window.

truncated.description: True when images remain after this nonempty page.

title: musicbrainz-mcp-server: get cover art
